items.name: Gowree Sankar
items.text: Such a lovely little shop! Stationary Point has a great selection of cute cards, books, pens and a variety of craft materials. Definitely a go to spot for anyone who loves stationery in kochi!

items.name: Akhil John Koshy
items.text:
I recently visited this stationary shop called "Stationary Point" and was blown away by the amazing selection of products they had to offer. From pens and pencils to notebooks and journals, this shop had everything I needed to get organized and stay on top of my work.

The staffs were incredibly friendly and helpful, offering suggestions and advice on the best products to suit my needs. They were knowledgeable about the different brands and styles of stationary, and were able to help me find exactly what I was looking for.

The quality of the products was exceptional, with a wide range of high-quality pens, markers, and highlighters that made writing and note-taking a pleasure. The notebooks and journals were also of excellent quality, with sturdy covers and high-quality paper that made writing a joy.

Overall, I was extremely impressed with this stationary shop and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for high-quality stationary products. The staff were friendly and knowledgeable, the selection was excellent, and the quality of the products was exceptional. I will definitely be returning to this shop for all of my stationary needs in the future!

items.name: Yazinist
items.text: The store boasts an extensive selection of high-quality products, from elegant notebooks and premium pens to unique greeting cards and stylish organizers. The layout is both inviting and well-organized, making it easy to find exactly what you need. The staff is exceptionally friendly and knowledgeable, always ready to offer personalized recommendations and helpful advice. Whether you're a student, a professional, or just a stationery enthusiast, this shop is a true gem. I highly recommend it for anyone seeking beautiful, functional, and inspiring stationery.
